member.name: ResolveVisibleDevices
member.para: The confirmation. Against the project's two-GPU test box on 2026-07-28: over SSH our enumeration reported 0 = Intel UHD 630, 1 = NVIDIA GTX 1070, and GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 was the run that put the GTX at ~60% load in nvidia-smi while =0 left it at its idle baseline. On a single-GPU machine, =7 aborts the run with ggml_vulkan: Invalid device index 7 in GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES (2026-07-29).

Why an unparseable value yields null rather than a guess. The silent fallback it replaced (2026-07-29) already cost one confused test run on the remote machine, where a bare "Vulkan backend" was indistinguishable from GPU naming being broken.
